name: Igor
source:
Proprietor of the Velvet Room, a space between dream and reality, mind and matter. 
He's very interested in the nature of man and soul. 
Created by Phelemon, he later created the other Velvet Room attendants, starting with [url=/c53702] Margaret[/url].
